contracts: (The project-creation selector is discovered with a nonzero count and observes no creation-triggered Restore; then the full test suite is run.) AND (The project-creation snapshot selector is discovered with a nonzero count and observes no new Snapshot; then the full test suite is run.)
selector_intents: PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests creates a project and fails if project creation creates or starts any Restore operation without an explicit request.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests creates a project and fails if the snapshot manifest or persistence layer records a newly created Snapshot without an explicit request.
